svg.text: Route: /admin/raw-materials (popup) · Screen: 1280 px wide desktop browser · Access: Admin only (admin site, signed in)
• Admin only. Search sends the name to GET /api/nutrition/search (USDA FoodData Central; the API keeps the key). “Use” fills the four values per 100 g; they can also be typed from a label.
• Pieces (pc) need a weight per piece; ml may have grams per ml (blank = 1 g per ml; oil is about 0.92). When nutrition is already set, the popup shows “Linked to USDA food: …” with
Change, and a Remove nutrition button.
• Without USDA_API_KEY the search answers “Nutrition lookup isn't set up: add USDA_API_KEY to the API's environment”. Over USDA's hourly limit: “USDA's lookup limit was reached. Try again
